display_long_description:
Created by marine science non-profit Lionfish Central, and narrated by the world-renowned marine scientist and researcher: Dr. Steve Gittings, Shipwreck Discovery immerses players in the world of real shipwrecks off the coast of Destin, Florida. 
[media]
As a reef-tender, you are responsible for growing an artificial reef onto a freshly sunken ship. Cull Lionfish, collect trash, and grow corals to attract myriad varieties of marine life. Contribute to making the ocean a cleaner and more biodiverse place - virtually and in real life. A portion of every purchase goes to Lionfish Central which does the same critical work you will be doing in-game. 
[media]
Your coral won't grow all at once, and you can't speed run your way to a cleaner ocean. Featuring a real-time tracking system, you'll have to keep the wreck clean over multiple visits to see what each reef can truly flourish into. Enjoy the immersive underwater soundscape and interact with massive schools of lifelike fish that dynamically respond to you and your surroundings.
